name: Boneyard Acquaintance

source.title: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation

text: Before your soul returned from death, you interacted with a host of other souls on their way to the Boneyard. One of these acquaintances owes you a favor. You can temporarily summon it to come to your aid, and it appears as a swirling mass of ectoplasm with indiscernible features and a translucent dagger, the favored weapon of Pharasma. This functions as Spiritual Guardian that you can cast once per day as a 9th-rank divine innate spell.
